# AlwaysGreen fix workspace — connectors

Four repositories, because a connectors AlwaysGreen failure can need a change in any
of them:

|              Repo              |                              When it is the right place to fix                              |
|--------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `connectors`                   | connector, runtime, or bundle code — the image the failing run built and deployed           |
| `c8-cross-component-e2e-tests` | the Playwright specs and page objects that ran (`tests/SM-8.x/`, `tests/8.x/`)              |
| `camunda-platform-helm`        | chart values, templates, deploy config — including Keycloak/Identity wiring                 |
| `camunda-docs`                 | the authority on intended product behaviour; read before changing what an assertion expects |

The SM specs execute from the published `@camunda/e2e-test-suite` npm package, so a
report's `file` is a compiled basename. The source lives in
`c8-cross-component-e2e-tests` — the manual explains the mapping.

`connectors` is checked out at the branch that failed. The other three track `main`.

Connectors-specific rules the manual expands on, all CI-enforced:

- PR titles must match the conventional-commit regex, and **never** use `feat:` —
  that type requires a named QA approver and an agent PR must not enter that gate.
- Element templates are generated by each connector's `GenerateElementTemplate` test.
  Never hand-edit one, and never run Maven: escalate instead.
- Never hand cherry-pick a backport. Each branch's failure is dispatched against its
  own branch, so a backport should not arise; if one does, it goes through the
  `backport stable/X.Y` label.
